prompt:
High-fidelity desktop app UI mockup, macOS style window, WeChat-desktop-inspired light theme, Chinese UI, flat minimal design, no gradients, exact text rendering. Same app shell and same message center page as described: 28px near-white title bar with macOS traffic lights, slim left icon rail with 7 gray icons (bell icon active in WeChat green #07c160, red #fa5151 count pill "0" hidden), thin status bar at bottom.

CONTENT AREA (white, 24px padding): message center PAGE titled "消息中心", subtitle "入群邀请与好友邀请统一处理". Top-right of header: macOS segmented control, gray track, segment "待处理 0" unselected gray, segment "历史消息" SELECTED (white pill with subtle shadow).

Below, a slim filter row: three small outline chips "全部" (selected, dark border), "已同意", "已拒绝".

Two stacked sections with muted (slightly desaturated) card content to convey history.

SECTION 1 header: green #07c160 rounded-square chip with white group-of-users glyph, title "入群邀请", no count pill.
  Card 1: gray pill "收到的", group name "研发协作群", right-aligned: green text pill "已同意" on light gray pill background, gray time "昨天 21:40"; second line monospace gray peer id "12D3KooW…8f2a" with tiny copy icon.
  Card 2: gray pill "收到的", group name "读书会", right-aligned: gray text "已拒绝" on light gray pill, gray time "3月2日 08:15"; second line monospace peer id "12D3KooW…44ae" with tiny copy icon.

SECTION 2 header: soft blue rounded-square chip with white person-plus glyph, title "好友邀请", no count pill.
  Card 3: gray pill "收到的", name "赵六", right-aligned: green text "已同意" on light gray pill, gray time "2月28日 19:02"; second line monospace peer id "12D3KooW…7d10" with tiny copy icon; third line 12px note "备注：老同学".
  Card 4: gray pill "发出的", name "孙七", right-aligned: outline button "撤回" (for the one still waiting), gray pill "待处理", gray time "周一 11:26"; second line monospace peer id "12D3KooW…2e93" with tiny copy icon.

Overall: system sans-serif Chinese typography, muted grays, generous whitespace, crisp 1px borders, WeChat desktop aesthetic, light theme only.
